Title: 2026 Climate Resilience Grant Program
Description: The Nature Conservancy is offering a sixth round of Climate Resilience Grants in New York to support local conservation and climate adaptation efforts.

Title: Adaptation Planning Grant Program - Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation
Description: The program provides flexible funding to meet multi-sector/issue planning needs that intersect with climate risks, including but not limited to land use, transportation, economic, housing, natural resource management, public infrastructure, and hazard mitigation issues.

Title: Funding & Capacity | U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit
Description: Communities are often eligible to apply for grant funding from federal, state, non-profit, or private entities for resilience-building projects. They might also be able to raise funds for resilience actions through taxes or fees.

Title: Applying to the Innovating for Climate Resilience Fund
Description: January 16, 2025 - Through its Innovating for Climate Resilience Fund, GIF invests through grant, equity, and debt instruments, in innovations with the potential to scale and support the world’s poorest to build resilience and adaptation.

Title: Grant & Technical Assistance Opportunities | Office of Policy Innovation & Future
Description: Track 1 Community Enrollment Service Provider Grants enable organizations to assist up to five communities to prepare for and enroll in the Community Resilience Partnership and then apply for grant funds to undertake priority climate and energy projects.
